answer: The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own walnut record, and its own share of the summit quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The dawn ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 664 identities would post 3434 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
